title: P104: the odd unit, paid per grading — one cost behind the decoder wall and the t = −1 park (no κ)
body:
## Summary

This package collects one day of P104 research on the two fixed costs every redesign has hit: the decoder's 56 owned units per plane and the t = −1 park. It is organised in three parts:

- **Part I.** The lemmas and theorems, each with a proof and an exact standard-library check.
- **Part II.** Every route closed that day, stated as a scoped negative result with its reason and numbers.
- **Part III.** The words we built that did not pay, replayed exactly against #7546.

**No κ claim.** No new frontier word. Package: `research/p104-odd-unit-per-grading/`.

**One cost behind both walls.** Both costs are the same **odd unit**, paid separately in each port's own grading σ_p.

- o(N) = rank of N's σ-odd part, for any block, ring or port coupling.
- t = −1 holds exactly when the σ-even part is singular (the Cayley form of the park).
- Two ports never share a grading inside a word (05-layers.tex l.4–7, 86–91).
- The odd diagonal (q·q = 1) forces both an UP and a DOWN decoder in every plane.
- Every construction that tries to move the park elsewhere needs a **moved owned row**, about 1 unit per port per call against a break-even of 0.214. This is enforced by the Rank, Lock and Clone lemmas, Theorem W, NT, AS/VA, the lift law, the Freeze Lemma, the web-general Cut Lemma and the Commutation Theorem.

## Corrections of our own earlier statements

1. **The "one-rank law" is the Fredholm alternative (Theorem F).** Our drop-repair engines reported "every drop misses by exactly one rank". With one right-hand side that is only "infeasible". The contact-minimality conjecture we built on it carries no structure, and the rigidity it described is schedule-driven, with no lower bound (Descent Lemma).
2. **HALF18 (already commented on #7583).** The full-flag certificate minimum is not ≈ 18 = 2h. Exact frame certificates of rank 15 (E8-120) and 13 (P104) exist, with lower bound 8. #7583's proved bounds are unaffected.
3. **Internal notes only, never in a public PR.** Duality is type-preserving: U builds are not duals of L builds. EARLYCAP part B is refuted by T1CANCEL. BYPASS's relaxed screens were optimistic.

## How to verify

```
python3 -I -B research/p104-odd-unit-per-grading/odd_unit.py   # PASS_ODD_UNIT_PER_GRADING (<1 s)
python3 -I -B research/p104-odd-unit-per-grading/e8laws.py     # PASS_E8_LAWS (~3 s)
python3 -I -B research/p104-odd-unit-per-grading/walls.py      # PASS_WALL_TOYS (~70 s)
python3 -I -B research/p104-odd-unit-per-grading/onerank.py    # PASS_ONERANK (~3 s)
python3 -I -B research/p104-odd-unit-per-grading/cuts.py       # PASS_CUT_LEMMA (~40 s)
python3 -I -B research/p104-odd-unit-per-grading/words.py      # PASS_UNPAID_WORDS (~80 s)
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-odd-unit-per-grading
```

- All checks use the standard library only and exact arithmetic.
- Each has positive and negative controls.
- Part III ships every word as an edit list against the vendored #7546 word (or against W6805 for the feeder), with a pinned SHA256.

| word | result |
|---|---|
| SEEDBUILD S1 | +21.34 D0/call, κ ×0.999069 |
| relocation control | +16.82 D0/call, ×0.999268 |
| Lemma RT swaps (mains 6 and 886) | κ identical to #7546 in every digit |
| WINDOW8 merged window | X = x − y, Y = x + y exact on 8 ports; 201.12 D0/call on the window route; no κ (merged plane) |

## Caveats and open questions

- **Lane-only numbers.** Numbers tagged [C-lane] are exact computations by our lane code and are not re-run in CI. [C-param] prices come from our invoice tool, whose control reproduces #7546's κ and S = 1424. Neither is a new claim against the frontier.
- **Open.** Whether one owned ascent can be shared between t = −1 ports. Up-set cuts allow it, and no realisation is known; an exact F2³ decision is in progress and not claimed here.
- **Open.** The d = 1 early-set window.
- **Open.** ≥ 6 replacement rows and the h = 9 wall (C ≥ 52).
- **Open.** A rank ≥ 9 free-lift decoder network below 56.
- **Not included.** A network-compiler effort is ongoing; nothing from it is included.
